subject: Reschedule: Demo & prep window for Atlas Retail pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@atlasretail.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Danielle Ruiz <d.ruiz@atlasretail.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed demo week of Nov 2 — sample data attached

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking this. We’d like to schedule a live demo for the pilot workstream. Our initial preference was the week of Nov 2 — ideally Nov 4 or Nov 5 — but Danielle and I will be traveling early that week and thought it best to confirm availability.

I’m attaching a small slice of our catalog CSV and a short doc with access details so you can validate data ingestion ahead of time. Can your team also confirm they can run against SKU-level traces (approx 1.2M rows) and whether you need any additional sample prompt sets or expected output schemas?

Proposed time options (PST):
- Fri, Nov 4 | 10:00–11:00
- Mon, Nov 7 | 13:00–14:00

If those don’t work, happy to move. We want a crisp, prepared demo — would prefer to move rather than rush.

Attachments: [Attachment: atlas_sample_data_schema.csv (CSV, 42KB)], [Attachment: access_instructions.pdf (PDF, 110KB)]

Thanks,
Samantha
Sr. Product Manager
Atlas Retail
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@atlasretail.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed demo week of Nov 2 — sample data attached

Hi Samantha — thanks for the data and the clear options. Quick notes:

1) We can ingest the CSV slice; our infra team will validate schema against your SKU traces.
2) To do a full, production-representative demo (including latency and batch behavior) we need a short prep window: one dry-run with your sample traces and one prompt-set review.
3) Our engineering lead, Aditya, and AE Neha are looped for scheduling and confirmation of access scopes.

Given some internal travel and a leadership review that week, I can’t guarantee full ops readiness for Nov 4/5. Can we move to either Nov 9 or Nov 10 (PST)? That gives us a dry-run on Nov 6/7 and time to set up temporary read-only S3 access and response format validation. Proposed calendar:

- Fri, Nov 6 | internal dry-run (30m) — Redwood only
- Mon, Nov 9 | customer-facing demo (45m) — demo + 15m Q&A

Prep checklist for Atlas Retail (what we need from you):
- Confirm read-only S3 path or temporary upload (presigned URLs)
- Provide a 3–5 example QA prompt set and expected output examples
- Confirm whether we can run the 1.2M-row trace in a reduced sample (recommended 5–10% for dry-run)
- Account contacts for engineering access (SSH/role names if using GCP/AWS IAM)

If Nov 9/10 works, I’ll send calendar invites and a short Ops runbook. If not, please propose two alternate slots between Nov 9–12.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access_instructions.pdf referenced above]
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: internal: Atlas demo scheduling — quick alignment

Looping to confirm: I’m available to own the customer invite and the dry-run facilitation on Nov 6. Aditya — can we reserve a GPU slot for a dry-run between 09:00–11:00 PST on Nov 6? If Aditya is blocked, I can push to Nov 7 afternoon.

Also adding two quick ops steps I’ll take:
- Prepare a minimal prompt set template for Atlas (will attach to the invite)
- Create a temporary S3 bucket policy example (read-only) we can hand to the Atlas infra contact

Neha
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T07:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: internal: Atlas demo scheduling — quick alignment

Heads up — leadership town hall moved to Nov 9 morning, I’m booked for that day and can't do Mon morning. Nov 10 (afternoon PST) is better for me. I suggest we keep the internal dry-run on Nov 6 as planned, then propose customer-facing demos on Nov 10 (14:00 PST) or Nov 11 (10:00 PST).

If Nov 10 works for Atlas, Neha can push the invite and include the runbook. Also confirm that the reduced trace sample is acceptable for the dry-run; we should avoid running the full 1.2M rows before the pilot agreement.

- Aditya
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@atlasretail.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Danielle Ruiz <d.ruiz@atlasretail.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T16:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Demo & prep window for Atlas Retail pilot

Thanks — Nov 10 at 14:00 PST works for us. Appreciate the flexibility; we can provide a 10% sample of the trace for the dry-run and will make the full dataset available post-contract.

Next steps I’ll take today:
- Share a short prompt set (3 examples) and expected output schema by EOD
- Provide a contact for our infra team (Danielle) to accept the S3 policy and arrange a presigned upload
- Confirm attendee list — will include product and two engineering leads

If you can send the calendar invite and the dry-run slot, we’ll accept and prepare. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Samantha
Sr. Product Manager, Atlas Retail
